Name: Shared Perfection
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]This mod changes calculations for the following entries when determining game perfection:[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Produce and Forage Shipped[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Monster Slayer Hero[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Great Friends[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Farmer Level[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Found All Stardrops[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Cooking Recipes Made[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Crafting Recipes Made[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fish Caught[/color]

calculating each of these based on any player having completed a given item in each entry, as opposed to one player having fully completed every item. So, for example, if any player has shipped a valid item for the Produce and Forage Shipped, it counts for that achievement; if any player is level 25 or greater, it counts for that achievement, etc.

[color=#D4D4D8]The rest of the calculations are already player independent.[/color]


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
